session.summary: User shared recommendations for books, films, and games, requesting them to be organized into three files in a directory named 'Recommendations'.

records.content: The Night Circus by Erin Morgenstern: A mesmerizing tale of magic and competition with lush, dreamlike prose. Project Hail Mary by Andy Weir: Gripping sci-fi with a perfect blend of humor, science, and heart-warming moments. The Shadow of the Wind by Carlos Ruiz Zafón: Atmospheric literary mystery set in Barcelona that pulls you into its world completely.

details.title: Book Recommendations
details.notes: Consider exploring these books for leisure reading or book club discussions.

records.content: The Grand Budapest Hotel by Wes Anderson: Visually stunning comedy with incredible attention to detail and a surprising emotional core. Drive My Car: Beautifully patient Japanese drama about grief, art, and human connection that stays with you. Portrait of a Lady on Fire: Exquisite period romance with breathtaking cinematography and powerful performances.

details.title: Film Recommendations
details.notes: These films offer a range of genres and emotional depth, perfect for movie nights or thematic analysis.

records.content: Hades: Roguelike masterpiece with tight combat, incredible character work, and Greek mythology brought brilliantly to life. Outer Wilds: Unique space exploration game built around curiosity and discovery with an unforgettable time loop mechanic. Celeste: Challenging platformer with gorgeous pixel art that weaves mental health themes into both story and gameplay.

details.title: Game Recommendations
details.notes: These games offer diverse genres and themes, suitable for both casual and dedicated gaming sessions.
